The '''2022 Retro League Event 5''' was the fifth event of the [[2022 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (18 September – 1 November 2022), played in [[Premiere - Reflections II]] format. 43 players registered, and [[Andrew Bethell]] won.<ref name="t80298" /><ref name="t80048" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 18 September – 1 November 2022
* '''Structure:''' six games of Swiss, one game a week, scored by strength of schedule; 45-minute timers per side<ref name="t80048" /><ref name="t80194" />
* '''Players:''' 43
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Bethell]]
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Sanders]]<ref name="t80296" />

Andrew Bethell went 6-0.<ref name="p1392951" />

== Final standings ==
Places are the "Event 5 Final Standings" posted by the tournament director, in posted order; the posted list marks place 34 as a tie.<ref name="p1392951">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1392951#p1392951 "Event 5 Final Standings" post], Leverandon, 3 November 2022, in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80298 Event #5 - 2022 Retro GEMP League - P-REFII Constructed], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012161052/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80298.html#p1392951 Internet Archive].</ref> '''Event 5 points''' are derived: each player's total in the final cumulative league rankings<ref name="p1392952">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1392952#p1392952 Final Cumulative League Rankings], Leverandon, 3 November 2022, in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80597 2022 Retro League Cumulative Standings], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012161227/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80597.html#p1392952 Internet Archive].</ref> minus his total after Event 4<ref name="p1387680">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1387680#p1387680 Cumulative Standings (Updated After Event 4, September 9)], Leverandon, 9 September 2022, in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80597 2022 Retro League Cumulative Standings], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012161227/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80597.html#p1387680 Internet Archive].</ref> (league points: 3 per win, 1 per loss, plus 4 for the event winner and 2 for the runner-up). Players new in Event 5 had no Event 4 total. Event places were decided by strength of schedule, which the cumulative posts do not show, so players on equal points keep the posted order. The derived points do not fully follow the posted order: Peter Hansen and Trevor Brown (10) and Daniel Drentlaw (8) are placed above Andrew Thomas (12), and Andrew Bethell's 24 is two more than the 22 a 6-0 winner should earn. The places shown follow the posted standings.
